import type { SpeciesId, Stage } from '../../types'
import * as S from './sprites.ts'
import type { Sprite } from './sprites.ts'

// Who the pet can be. It hatches as a Bit, grows into a Nibble, then a teen picked by how well it
// was cared for, then one of eight adults picked by care and by the work it watched Claude do.

export type Species = {
  id: SpeciesId
  name: string
  stage: Stage
  sprite: Sprite
  /** One line about it, for the stats page and the README. */
  blurb: string
  /** How it is reached, for the evolution chart. */
  how: string
  /** Grams it weighs when it reaches this form. */
  weight: number
  /** Its face beside the spinner and in the one-line band: content, then sleepy. */
  face: string
}

export const SPECIES: Record<SpeciesId, Species> = {
  egg: { id: 'egg', name: 'Egg', stage: 'egg', sprite: S.EGG, blurb: 'Something is moving inside.', how: 'Where every pet starts.', weight: 5, face: '( )' },
  bit: { id: 'bit', name: 'Bit', stage: 'baby', sprite: S.BIT, blurb: 'The smallest unit of joy.', how: 'Hatches after a minute and a tool call.', weight: 5, face: '(•ω•)' },
  nibble: { id: 'nibble', name: 'Nibble', stage: 'child', sprite: S.NIBBLE, blurb: 'Four bits of mischief.', how: '1 hour old and 40 tool calls watched.', weight: 10, face: '(=^ω^=)' },
  bytey: { id: 'bytey', name: 'Bytey', stage: 'teen', sprite: S.BYTEY, blurb: 'A well-raised teenager. Eight bits, all in order.', how: '1 day old, 250 tool calls, few care mistakes.', weight: 18, face: 'ʕ•ω•ʔ' },
  glitchy: { id: 'glitchy', name: 'Glitchy', stage: 'teen', sprite: S.GLITCHY, blurb: 'Some of its bits got flipped along the way.', how: '1 day old, 250 tool calls, many care mistakes.', weight: 16, face: '(⊙_⊙)' },
  assertoise: { id: 'assertoise', name: 'Assertoise', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.ASSERTOISE, blurb: 'Slow, steady, and every test green. Carries the checkmark on its back.', how: 'Grows up watching Claude run tests.', weight: 30, face: '(✓_✓)' },
  refactopus: { id: 'refactopus', name: 'Refactopus', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.REFACTOPUS, blurb: 'Eight arms, eight files open, zero fear of a big diff.', how: 'Grows up watching Claude edit code.', weight: 26, face: '(◕ω◕)' },
  shellby: { id: 'shellby', name: 'Shellby', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.SHELLBY, blurb: 'Lives in the terminal. Pipes things into other things.', how: 'Grows up watching Claude run shell commands.', weight: 24, face: '(°▽°)' },
  grepossum: { id: 'grepossum', name: 'Grepossum', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.GREPOSSUM, blurb: 'Reads every file before it says a word. Finds what you lost.', how: 'Grows up watching Claude read and search.', weight: 22, face: '(ºoº)' },
  commitmunk: { id: 'commitmunk', name: 'Commitmunk', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.COMMITMUNK, blurb: 'Stuffs its cheeks with commits and buries them in the reflog.', how: 'Grows up watching Claude commit and push.', weight: 28, face: '(^•^)' },
  owlgorithm: { id: 'owlgorithm', name: 'Owlgorithm', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.OWLGORITHM, blurb: 'Does its best work after midnight. Who? You.', how: 'Grows up coding late at night.', weight: 25, face: '(⊙v⊙)' },
  spaghetto: { id: 'spaghetto', name: 'Spaghetto', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.SPAGHETTO, blurb: 'Tangled, saucy, and somehow still running in production.', how: 'Grows up with many care mistakes.', weight: 34, face: '(@_@)' },
  unicorn: { id: 'unicorn', name: 'Unicorn', stage: 'adult', sprite: S.UNICORN, blurb: 'The mythical 10x pet. Raised with perfect care and firm discipline.', how: 'At most one care mistake and discipline of 75 or more.', weight: 22, face: '(✧ω✧)' },
}

export const ADULTS: readonly SpeciesId[] = ['assertoise', 'refactopus', 'shellby', 'grepossum', 'commitmunk', 'owlgorithm', 'spaghetto', 'unicorn']

export const species = (id: SpeciesId): Species => SPECIES[id] ?? SPECIES.bit

export const isSpecies = (value: unknown): value is SpeciesId => typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(SPECIES, value)

import type { Need, Pet } from '../../types'
import { hearts, stageOf } from './life.ts'
import { species } from './species.ts'

// What the pet looks like and says in text: its face, its meters, the line about how it is doing.

export const meter = (value: number, full = '♥', empty = '♡'): string => full.repeat(hearts(value)) + empty.repeat(4 - hearts(value))

/** Discipline as four bars. */
export const bars = (value: number): string => '■'.repeat(hearts(value)) + '□'.repeat(4 - hearts(value))

/** Its face as text: for the spinner and the one-line band. */
export function face(p: Pet): string {
  if (p.gone) return '(  )'
  if (p.species === 'egg') return '( )'
  if (p.asleep) return '(-_-)zZ'
  if (p.sick > 0) return '(×_×)'
  if (p.tantrum) return '(ò_ó)'
  if (p.hunger <= 0 || p.happy <= 0) return '(;_;)'
  if (p.happy < 40) return '(._.)'
  return species(p.species).face
}

export const NEED_TEXT: Record<Need, string> = {
  hungry: 'is hungry',
  sad: 'is bored and sad',
  sick: 'is sick: medicine!',
  bugs: 'is surrounded by bugs',
  tantrum: 'is throwing a tantrum',
}

/** One line about how it is doing, most pressing first. */
export function statusLine(p: Pet): string {
  if (p.gone) return `${p.name} has left for the cloud. /tama new for a new egg`
  if (p.vacation !== null) return `${p.name} is on vacation. /tama vacation off when you are back`
  if (p.species === 'egg') return 'an egg. it hatches when Claude gets to work'
  if (p.calling) return `${p.name} ${NEED_TEXT[p.calling]}`
  if (p.tucked) return `${p.name} is tucked in`
  if (p.asleep) return `${p.name} is napping`
  if (p.bugs > 0) return `${p.name} left ${p.bugs === 1 ? 'a bug' : `${p.bugs} bugs`} behind`
  if (p.hunger < 30) return `${p.name} is getting peckish`
  if (p.happy < 30) return `${p.name} wants to play`
  return `${p.name} is ${p.happy >= 75 ? 'happy' : 'doing fine'}`
}

export function title(p: Pet): string {
  const s = species(p.species)
  return stageOf(p) === 'egg' ? 'an egg' : `${p.name} the ${s.name}`
}

export const compact = (n: number): string =>
  n >= 1_000_000 ? `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M` : n >= 10_000 ? `${Math.round(n / 1000)}k` : n >= 1000 ? `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : `${n}`

/** What the pet says when a need starts calling. */
export const CALL_SAYS: Record<Need, string> = {
  hungry: 'my tummy is empty…',
  sad: 'play with me?',
  sick: 'i feel funny… (×_×)',
  bugs: 'so… many… bugs',
  tantrum: 'NO NO NO NO',
}

export const HELP: readonly [string, string][] = [
  ['/tama', 'open or close the device'],
  ['/tama feed · snack', 'a meal fills a heart of hunger, a snack a heart of fun'],
  ['/tama play', 'the left-or-right game: win 3 of 5'],
  ['/tama clean', 'squash the bugs it left behind'],
  ['/tama medicine', 'cure it when it is sick (sometimes twice)'],
  ['/tama lights', 'tuck it in, or wake it up'],
  ['/tama scold', 'discipline a tantrum (never a well-behaved pet)'],
  ['/tama stats · history', 'its life in numbers, and the pets before it'],
  ['/tama name <name>', 'rename it'],
  ['/tama shell <color>', 'coral, mint, grape, sky, banana or ink'],
  ['/tama band auto|big|on|line|off', 'how it shows above the prompt'],
  ['/tama vacation on|off', 'stop its clock while you are away'],
  ['/tama mode classic|gentle', 'gentle: it never leaves, however neglected'],
  ['/tama spinner · sound on|off', 'its face beside the spinner; beeps'],
]

files.types/index.d.ts:
// cc-tamagotchi's type contract: the values it keeps in $.state, and the shapes they are made of.

export type SpeciesId =
  | 'egg'
  | 'bit'
  | 'nibble'
  | 'bytey'
  | 'glitchy'
  | 'assertoise'
  | 'refactopus'
  | 'shellby'
  | 'grepossum'
  | 'commitmunk'
  | 'owlgorithm'
  | 'spaghetto'
  | 'unicorn'

export type Stage = 'egg' | 'baby' | 'child' | 'teen' | 'adult'

/** What Claude's work and the person's care added up to over the pet's life. */
export type PetStats = {
  toolCalls: number
  edits: number
  tests: number
  testFails: number
  commits: number
  pushes: number
  shell: number
  searches: number
  agents: number
  errors: number
  turns: number
  nightTurns: number
  tokens: number
  meals: number
  snacks: number
  games: number
  wins: number
  cleans: number
  meds: number
  pats: number
  scolds: number
}

/** The pet, as kept in $.store and shared by every session on the machine. */
export type Pet = {
  v: 1
  /** Seeds every random choice its life makes, so all sessions simulate the same pet. */
  id: string
  name: string
  species: SpeciesId
  generation: number
  /** When the egg appeared, when it hatched, and when its current form began (ms since the epoch). */
  born: number
  hatchedAt: number | null
  evolvedAt: number
  /** How far its life has been simulated, a whole minute at a time. */
  at: number
  /** 0 to 100: four hearts of 25. */
  hunger: number
  happy: number
  discipline: number
  /** Grams. */
  weight: number
  /** Bugs on the screen: what this pet leaves behind. At most four. */
  bugs: number
  /** Doses of medicine still needed; 0 is healthy. */
  sick: number
  asleep: boolean
  /** Put to bed by the person: Claude's work does not wake it. */
  tucked: boolean
  /** The last time Claude or the person did anything. After a while without, it naps. */
  lastActive: number
  lastMeal: number | null
  lastPat: number
  tantrum: boolean
  /** The need it is calling about, the awake minutes it has waited, and whether that was counted. */
  calling: Need | null
  callWait: number
  callingCounted: boolean
  /** Care mistakes: a call left unanswered for too long. They shape what it grows into. */
  mistakes: number
  /** Minutes of hard neglect (starving and miserable, or sick); in classic mode too many and it leaves. */
  neglect: number
  /** When a vacation began: its time stands still until the person ends it. */
  vacation: number | null
  gone: { at: number; cause: 'neglect' } | null
  rev: number
  stats: PetStats
}

export type Need = 'hungry' | 'sad' | 'sick' | 'bugs' | 'tantrum'

/** One line of the hall of fame: a pet that has gone. */
export type Memorial = {
  name: string
  species: SpeciesId
  generation: number
  born: number
  gone: number
  toolCalls: number
  commits: number
}

export type BandMode = 'auto' | 'big' | 'on' | 'line' | 'off'
export type ShellColor = 'coral' | 'mint' | 'grape' | 'sky' | 'banana' | 'ink'

export type Settings = {
  band: BandMode
  /** Show the pet's face beside the spinner while Claude works. */
  spinner: boolean
  sound: boolean
  /** classic: a badly neglected pet leaves. gentle: it never does. */
  mode: 'classic' | 'gentle'
  shell: ShellColor
}

export type ReactionKind =
  | 'eat'
  | 'snack'
  | 'refuse'
  | 'happy'
  | 'pat'
  | 'clean'
  | 'medicine'
  | 'scold'
  | 'cheer'
  | 'flinch'
  | 'party'
  | 'nibble'
  | 'hatch'
  | 'evolve'
  | 'sleep'
  | 'wake'
  | 'win'
  | 'lose'

/** An animation the screens play once. `id` grows with each, so a screen knows a new one began. */
export type Reaction = { kind: ReactionKind; id: number; at: number; from?: SpeciesId }

export type View = 'main' | 'stats' | 'help' | 'history' | 'game' | 'name'

/** The left-or-right game: five rounds, three wins make it happy. */
export type Game = {
  round: number
  wins: number
  /** Which way it looked last round, and which way the person guessed. */
  answer: 'left' | 'right' | null
  guess: 'left' | 'right' | null
  isOver: boolean
}

export type Speech = { text: string; at: number }

// inside the augmentation a name resolves in claude-code first (it has a Settings of its own),
// so the contract names its values through aliases no module there shares
export type TamagotchiPet = Pet
export type TamagotchiSettings = Settings
export type TamagotchiView = View
export type TamagotchiGame = Game
export type TamagotchiReaction = Reaction
export type TamagotchiSpeech = Speech
export type TamagotchiMemorial = Memorial

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'cc-tamagotchi': {
      pet: TamagotchiPet | null
      settings: TamagotchiSettings
      view: TamagotchiView
      game: TamagotchiGame | null
      reaction: TamagotchiReaction | null
      speech: TamagotchiSpeech | null
      working: boolean
      graveyard: TamagotchiMemorial[]
    }
  }
}
